facts.fact: 周日两人牵手走向广场，每个路口门口他都停下来吻她。
facts.anchor: Amrita sighed happily as she and Jamie walked towards Hudsbury’s main square

facts.fact: 失控的马载着女骑手冲过，她脚卡在马镫，被甩飞砸在石板路上。
facts.anchor: The horse raced past, young rider flailing, her foot caught in the stirrup

facts.fact: 她不假思索跪下急救，自报受过训练，问出姓名 Susan。
facts.anchor: Amrita skidded to her knees by the girl before she stopped to think

facts.fact: 她脱下外套盖住 Susan，只做呼吸监测与头部固定，不动伤者。
facts.anchor: shrugged off her coat and draped it over the girl

facts.fact: 一股热流从她掌下涌入 Susan，几次呼吸间她的呼吸稳定并与 Amrita 同步。
facts.anchor: heat flooded through her, a gentle, stable stream

facts.fact: 医生 Rissa 到场，按脊柱保护流程接手，要她维持住「咒」。
facts.anchor: I’m Rissa. One of the doctors. Can you hold on to your spell

facts.fact: Rayenne 用旁遮普语、英语和上百种语言命令她「放手」。
facts.anchor: in Punjabi, English, and a hundred other languages

facts.fact: 她得知 Jamie 一直瞒着她，甩开他冲出到街上。
facts.anchor: she yanked away and stumbled, eyes streaming, out to the street
